name: klaviyo-mcp
description: Klaviyo MCP: campaigns, flows, segments, metrics, reports, profiles across many accounts. 24 tools.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all configured Klaviyo accounts.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List recent email campaigns for a specific Klaviyo account.

tools.name: campaign_report
tools.description: Get email campaign performance metrics for a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: list_metrics
tools.description: List available metrics for a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: multi_account_summary
tools.description: Pull campaign performance summary from ALL configured Klaviyo accounts.

tools.name: flow_report
tools.description: Get email flow (automation) performance for a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: campaign_ab_report
tools.description: Get per-variation (A/B arm) email/SMS campaign metrics for a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: flow_series_report
tools.description: Time-series flow (automation) metrics for a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: segment_report
tools.description: Segment performance metrics for a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: form_report
tools.description: Sign-up form performance for a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: list_segments
tools.description: List all segments in a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: List all email lists in a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: list_flows
tools.description: List all flows (automations) in a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: get_campaign_detail
tools.description: Get full details for a single campaign by ID.

tools.name: list_suppressed_profiles
tools.description: List profiles suppressed from email marketing for a single reason.

tools.name: metric_aggregate
tools.description: Aggregate values for any Klaviyo metric over a custom timeframe and interval.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Fetch an email template by ID, including HTML/text content.

tools.name: list_recent_events
tools.description: List recent events for a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: account_info
tools.description: Get Klaviyo account metadata.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tags in a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List email templates in a Klaviyo account.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Look up a customer profile by email or profile ID.

tools.name: get_flow_detail
tools.description: Get a flow's structure by ID.

tools.name: custom_report
tools.description: Expert escape hatch: run any Klaviyo values or series report.

klaviyo_key_main.title: Klaviyo API key (main account)
klaviyo_key_main.description: Private API key for your main Klaviyo account, mapped to KLAVIYO_KEY_MAIN. For multiple accounts, use Claude Code or Codex and add extra KLAVIYO_KEY_<name> environment variables.

api_base.title: API base URL
api_base.description: Override the Klaviyo API base URL

retry_base_ms.title: Retry base delay (ms)
retry_base_ms.description: Base delay in milliseconds for the retry backoff
